subject: DPA: alignment on backup purge offsets + temporary restore hold request
messages:
From: Sana Dutta <sana@medisync.ai>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@medisync.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Urgent: temporary hold + backup purge offsets for ongoing regulatory inquiry

Hi Irene,

We're in the middle of a regulatory information request and need Redwood's help to preserve a narrow set of backups and logs for a 90-day evidentiary hold. The scope: all backups and associated logs for tenant medisync-prod-17 between 2026-06-01 and 2026-07-15.

Requests:
- Can you place an administrative restore hold on the last full snapshot (snapshot id attached) and suspend any automated purge for that tenant for 90 days?
- Provide a list of subprocessors that handle backups or long-term storage AND their typical backup purge windows.
- Confirm whether any cross-border transfer is implicated for those backups and whether we need a separate DPA amendment.

I've attached the snapshot id we believe is relevant and our current subprocessor contact. We need confirmation by EOD Tuesday (your timezone) if possible.

Thanks — Sana
Sana Dutta
Head of Ops, Medisync
sana@medisync.ai

Sana — thanks for the details and the attachments. We can implement a time-limited administrative hold and pause purge for the specified snapshot/tenant while we validate scope.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I'll create an Ops ticket and request a hold in the backup orchestration system (OPS-1147).
- Kimberley (legal) will confirm whether the DPA covers this kind of evidentiary hold or if we need a short amendment.
- Marissa (service ops) and Karthik (security/compliance) will enumerate affected subprocessors and provide purge-window specifics and any cross-border notes.

Can you confirm the exact tenant ID and whether the hold should include incremental snapshots and the associated audit/log bundles? Also confirm the preferred contact for compliance questions (legal or privacy).

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Cc: contracts@medisync.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 20:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Urgent: temporary hold + backup purge offsets for ongoing regulatory inquiry

Sana / Irene — copying in a quick checklist from Legal. High level: we are generally able to implement a temporary hold for a defined scope without a DPA amendment, provided the customer is requesting preservation for compliance/legal reasons and confirms scope in writing (which you just did).

Action items for Medisync (please):
- Confirm in a signed email or DocuSign that the hold is limited to tenant medisync-prod-17 and the date range you specified.
- Confirm whether you want us to include incremental snapshots and logs; if so, list which log buckets.

Redwood Legal will prepare a short confirmation letter that documents the hold and the expected retention timeline (90 days). If cross-border copies exist, we will flag for DPA review — typically that triggers an information-only amendment rather than a full DPA renegotiation.

Kimberly Park
General Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 02:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Urgent: temporary hold + backup purge offsets for ongoing regulatory inquiry

I looked up the tenant and the snapshot id. Quick operational notes:
- Current retention policy for medisync-prod-17: daily full + incremental snapshots; default purge for full snapshots = 30 days; incrementals = 14 days; audit/log buckets are on a 45-day TTL.
- Subprocessors that touch backups: CloudStore (US-EAST), GlacierPartner (cross-region archival), FastLog (log ingestion). See attached 'backup-purge-matrix.csv' for windows and contact person.
- To implement the hold we will:
  1) Create an immutable hold tag on snapshot id X-20260714-prod-17 (prevents automated purge).
  2) Suspend the retention job targeting medisync-prod-17 for 90 days.
  3) Quarantine any cross-region archival jobs for manual review.

Risks/notes:
- If GlacierPartner already archived a copy to an EU location, we will need to record that transfer and route to Legal (Kimberly) for an info-only DPA addendum.
- We can only promise the hold on copies Redwood controls — for deep-archive subprocessors we will request expedited retention from that vendor (they have a 72h SLA).

I've attached the matrix and a short runbook. I'll take the OPS ticket and ping the vendor contacts as soon as we have Medisync's written confirmation.

Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance Engineer
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
(attachment: backup-purge-matrix.csv)

Sana — thanks for the quick reply earlier; this thread documents our mutual action plan. Summary & next steps:

Summary:
- Scope: tenant medisync-prod-17, backups and logs between 2026-06-01 and 2026-07-15 (includes full and incremental snapshots plus audit buckets).
- Hold length: 90 days from hold enactment.
- Redwood's responsibilities: create hold tag, suspend purge jobs, notify/coordinate with subprocessors, provide written confirmation letter.
- Medisync's responsibilities: provide signed confirmation (email or DocuSign) and designate a primary compliance contact (please confirm if contracts@medisync.ai is the right contact).

Milestones (target dates):
- 2026-07-21 20:00 UTC — Redwood to create hold and send confirmation letter (assuming signed confirmation by Medisync).
- 2026-07-23 — Redwood to complete subprocessor outreach and report back with any cross-border copies.
- 2026-07-24 — Legal to prepare written notice of hold for both parties to retain.

If Medisync confirms scope and signs off by EOD today, we will enact the hold per the timeline above. I'll update OPS-1147 and attach the legal hold letter when it's ready.

Irene Choi
